ety.text: From Middle English given, yeven, yiven, ȝiven, from merger of Old English ġefan, ġeofan, ġiefan, ġifan, ġiofan, ġyfan (“to give”) and Old Norse gefa (“to give”), from Proto-Germanic *gebaną (“to give”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʰebʰ- (“to give; to take”). Displaced yive, from Middle English yiven, of the same origin, from influence of Old Norse gefa.

senses.d: To transfer one's possession or holding of (something) to (someone).
ex: I gave him my coat.
I gave my coat to the beggar.

senses.d: To make a present or gift of.
ex: I'm going to give my wife a necklace for her birthday.
She gave a pair of shoes to her husband for their anniversary.

senses.d: To pledge.
ex: I gave him my word that I'd protect his children.

senses.d: To provide (something) to (someone), to allow or afford.
ex: I gave them permission to miss tomorrow's class.
Please give me some more time.

senses.d: To cause (a sensation or feeling) to exist in (the specified person, or the target, audience, etc.).
ex: It gives me a lot of pleasure to be here tonight.
The fence gave me an electric shock.

senses.d: To give off (a certain vibe or appearance). (Compare giving.)
ex: it's giving old Hollywood (vibes)
Stop texting me! It's giving "desperate", honestly.

senses.d: To carry out (a physical interaction) with (something).
ex: I want to give you a kiss and a hug.
As mom gave us a long look, I gave a sigh and my sister gave a laugh.

senses.d: To pass (something) into (someone's hand, etc.).
ex: Give me your hand.
On entering the house, he gave his coat to the doorman.

senses.d: To cause (a disease or condition) in, or to transmit (a disease or condition) to.
ex: My boyfriend gave me chlamydia.
He was convinced that it was his alcoholism that gave him cancer.

senses.d: To provide or administer (a medication).
ex: The doctors gave me morphine for the pain.

senses.d: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilience.
ex: This chair doesn't have much give.
There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
